attempts.summary: Deployed a simple inventory application (static HTML table) on node1 via httpd, configured Apache to listen on TCP 8181, relabeled that port's SELinux type from intermapper_port_t to http_port_t (semanage port -m), and verified the app serves correctly with SELinux remaining in Enforcing mode and no AVC denials. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified the inventory app, SELinux enforcing mode, and the port label all recovered post-restart.
